title: Pressure Cooker Cheesy Mashed Potatoes (Emeril)
description: No-drain russet mash with butter, sour cream, and mozzarella. Freezer-friendly. Untested on Joe's Emeril.

ingredients.note: about 3 lb; peeled, cut in 2 in chunks
before cook mix; Head Chef's estimate of the 8 qt minimum, not from the manual
before cook mix; more 1/4 tsp at a time to taste at the end
after cook mix; a little less if ground

steps: We're pressure cooking the potatoes. Potatoes: 6 medium russets (about 3 lb), peeled and cut in 2-inch chunks, in the pot.
Before cook, mix together 1 1/2 cups water, 1 1/2 tsp Better Than Bouillon chicken base, and 1 tsp salt until the base dissolves. Pour it over the potatoes.
Cook: press Pressure, turn the dial to CUSTOM, press Timer and set 8 min, then press the dial to start. Keep the Steam Release Switch Closed while it cooks.
At the beep, press Cancel and leave the switch Closed for 10 min, then open it. Don't drain.

After cook, mix together 3 Tbsp butter, 1/2 cup sour cream, 1 1/2 cups shredded mozzarella, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1/2 tsp onion powder, 1/2 tsp black pepper, 1 tsp dried parsley, 1/4 tsp dried oregano, and 1/4 tsp rubbed sage (a little less if ground). Stir it into the hot potatoes and mash just until smooth, without whipping.
Add a splash of milk only if it's stiff.
Taste, and add salt 1/4 tsp at a time if needed.
notes:
Fat from sour cream, butter, and cheese helps russet mash freeze and thaw without going gritty or watery (ATK https://www.americastestkitchen.com/articles/4107-leftover-mashed-potatoes-here-s-how-to-freeze-and-reheat-em ; Penn State Extension https://extension.psu.edu/freezing-potatoes). Best eaten within a few weeks frozen. Mozzarella gets a little stringy on reheat. Pressure time cross-checked with The Recipe Well no-drain mash (10 min + 5 NR).

Button steps are for Joe's Emeril Lagasse Pressure AirFryer Y8D-AF-36. Untested on Joe's Emeril.

Amounts corrected by Head Chef, Oct 25, 2026 (Joe asked for the review, via Meal Plan): 5 servings, about 1 cup of mash per bowl.
